title: Pullback of a perfect module of tor dimension at most one along a blowup is already derived and stays perfect of tor dimension at most one
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness), section 'The local structure of a finite type module'
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts two things about a perfect O_X-module F of tor dimension <= 1 and an arbitrary blowup b : X' -> X: that the derived pullback Lb^*F coincides with the ordinary pullback b^*F, and that b^*F is again perfect of tor dimension <= 1 (statement lines 13223-13230). The proof is short but it is a genuine reduction rather than a citation: it passes to X = Spec(A), takes a two-term presentation 0 -> A^m -> A^n -> M -> 0 of the module M attached to F, recalls that the affine blowup algebra A[I/a] is a subring of the localization A_a, and then uses exactness of localization to transfer the injectivity of A_a^m -> A_a^n down to A[I/a]^m -> A[I/a]^n (proof lines 13233-13242). Locating the argument in the subring A[I/a] rather than in A_a, and noticing that the two-term presentation is what makes both assertions fall out at once, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
